link.title: Dexto API Reference
link.description: Welcome to the Dexto API documentation. Here you will find detailed information about using Dexto as a Library, and about our REST and SSE streaming APIs. The REST and SSE APIs are served by `startDextoServer` from `@dexto/server` in your own Node app; the `dexto` 2.0 CLI no longer runs a server.
